notes:
- Your Claude can now connect to VORP with one click in Settings, and send files to your friends for you.
- Share your AI session with a friend. They can watch it live from their own VORP, and any files it makes can land straight in their VORP too.
- New inbox: things friends share with you wait in one place until you open them.
- Fixed the right-click Send to Friend menu sometimes coming up empty.
- A fresh first screen, a smoother sign-in, and little fixes all around.
